content_signals.reader_job: Give the reader a clear decision path with visible, source-backed evidence.

accent_2.role: marker only; never a surface, fill, or large background

color_pairings.role: dominant accent labels and links on panels
accent_2 marker highlight; marker-only, never a fill

typography.mono: JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

extracted.grid: asymmetric editorial grid with hard alignment and negative space

signature_move.move: One dominant blue accent with an acid-lime marker on a warm-neutral, zero-radius asymmetric grid.
signature_move.reader_value: Establishes a strict decision-then-evidence reading order so source-backed decks stay scannable without a decorative card wall.

judgment.why_it_works: A single dominant accent over a warm-neutral ground, zero-radius hard alignment, large asymmetric type, and negative space carry hierarchy before any decoration. accent_2 is reserved as a marker and never becomes a surface, so emphasis stays semantic and source-backed evidence is never visually outranked by ornament.
anti_patterns: Multi-card walls of equal visual weight
Three consecutive slides at the same visual weight
Arbitrary hex colors outside the active design system
Using accent_2 as a card fill or large background

non_claims: Retrospective, digest-bound record; it is not cryptographically authenticated.
No real-user validation or business impact is claimed.
The record does not prove this system fits non-deck artifact types; it is seeded from the swiss evidence deck.
